comment: Optical database. Solar and IR properties are independent. Do not treat literature AAO as a measured STRATOVANE coupon.

materials.name: Bare aluminum, polished
materials.source: Typical polished aluminum solar absorptance/IR emittance ranges in Gilmore, Spacecraft Thermal Control Handbook, and NASA thermal-control tables. Alloy/finish specific data are NOT this sample.
materials.notes: IR emissivity of real Al depends on roughness, oxide, and wavelength. Treat as uncertain.

materials.name: Bare aluminum, oxidized
materials.source: Order-of-magnitude oxidized-aluminum values from spacecraft thermal-control compilations (Gilmore). Not a measured 6061 coupon.
materials.notes: Placeholder oxidized finish used as the default bare-aluminum comparison.

materials.name: Bare aluminum, rough
materials.source: Rough aluminum tends to raise both solar absorptance and IR emittance relative to a polished speculum. Values are LITERATURE-order placeholders.

materials.name: Generic white reference (placeholder)
materials.source: Generic white-paint placeholder inspired by typical spacecraft white coatings (e.g. Z-93-class αs~0.17 ε~0.92 in Gilmore). NOT the team's flight coating.
materials.notes: Replace solar_reflectance and IR_emissivity with the actual white coating chosen for the experiment.

materials.name: AAO-Al Díaz-Lobo 2023/24 literature benchmark
materials.source: Díaz-Lobo et al., ACS Appl. Opt. Mater. 2024, 2, 980-990, doi:10.1021/acsaom.3c00216. Rsolar~90%, εIR~95% in the atmospheric-window region for 12 μm, ~10% porosity, sulfuric family.
materials.notes: Benchmark only. Optical behavior depends on thickness, porosity, interpore distance, and incorporated electrolyte species.

materials.name: STRATOVANE AAO-Al (initialized from Díaz-Lobo literature, NOT measured)
materials.source: Initialized from Díaz-Lobo et al. 2023/24. This is NOT a measured STRATOVANE coupon.
materials.notes: User may override thickness, porosity, Rsolar, and εIR independently. Morphology is not a fabrication instruction.
